name: pet-studio-lite
description: Pet Studio Lite — 宠物包导入/检查/预览/配置/导出 Windows 便携桌宠

scripts.test: npm run test:petpack && npm run test:zip && npm run test:petdex && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:shimeji && npm run test:classic
scripts.smoke:electron: npm run build:pet && esbuild scripts/smoke-round2.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=scripts/smoke-round2.bundle.cjs --external:electron --packages=external && electron scripts/smoke-round2.bundle.cjs
scripts.smoke:multi: npm run build:pet && esbuild scripts/smoke-multi-runtime.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=scripts/smoke-multi-runtime.bundle.cjs --external:electron --packages=external && electron scripts/smoke-multi-runtime.bundle.cjs
scripts.export:shimeji-test: npm run build:pet && esbuild scripts/export-shimeji-acceptance.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=scripts/export-shimeji-acceptance.bundle.mjs --packages=external && node scripts/export-shimeji-acceptance.bundle.mjs
